release_notes:
## The reset buttons are now one ••• menu
- PHASE 1's secondary actions collapse into a single ••• menu: Reset Reel, Reset All, Rescan, and Disconnect. PHASE 2 gets the same, with Clear Queue and Rescan Episodes
- The reel is named in the menu itself — it reads "Reset Reel 2", not "reset this reel" — so which reel you are about to reset is never something you have to work out, including with Nest All on where the armed reel moves as the run advances
- Replaces the three separate buttons from 1.0.12, whose names described a difference that did not exist: "Reset status" and "Clear" did the same thing to a different number of reels, and "Clear" implied a deletion that never happens (nothing in Premiere is ever deleted by either — only this session's tracking of it is forgotten)
- Skip to Export stays a button of its own

## New — Disconnect
- Drops the Premiere connection and returns PHASE 1 to step 1, clearing the timeline scan, every reel's progress, and the export queue. Confirms first, and does not delete anything already created in Premiere
